department_name: Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children
description: State Government started a pension for disable person of the state. It provides monthly financial security to differently-abled persons who are permanent residents of Punjab.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 disbursed directly into the beneficiary's bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility_criteria: Permanent resident of Punjab; certified disability level of 40% or more (as certified by authorized government medical board); annual family income within prescribed low-income ceiling.
target_beneficiaries: Persons with disabilities (PwD), Differently-abled residents of Punjab
application_process: Apply online via Digital Punjab portal (eservices.punjab.gov.in) or submit physical application form through local Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) or Sewa Kendra.
required_documents: Disability Certificate issued by Civil Surgeon/Medical Board, Aadhaar Card, Punjab Domicile/Residence Certificate, Bank Account Passbook, Passport-size photographs.

department_name: Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children
description: State Government started a pension for old age person of the state people. It provides social security pensions for elderly citizens in Punjab who lack independent income sources.
benefits: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 transferred directly into beneficiary bank account via DBT.
eligibility_criteria: Permanent resident of Punjab; minimum age 65 years for men and 58 years for women; annual family income not exceeding ₹60,000; landholding not exceeding 2.5 acres nehri/chahi or 5 acres barani.
target_beneficiaries: Senior Citizens, Elderly women (58+), Elderly men (65+)
application_process: Apply online through Digital Punjab portal (eservices.punjab.gov.in) or visit nearest Sewa Kendra / District Social Security Officer.
required_documents: Age Proof (Birth Certificate/Voter ID/Matriculation Certificate), Proof of Punjab residence (Aadhaar/Domicile), Land Verification Report from Patwari (for rural applicants), Income Certificate, Bank Passbook.

department_name: Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children
description: State Government started a pension for Dependent Children of the state to support orphans or children deprived of parental support due to death or permanent disability of parents.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 per child (up to a maximum of two dependent children per family) payable until the child reaches 21 years of age.
eligibility_criteria: Permanent resident of Punjab; age below 21 years; parents deceased or father/breadwinner permanently incapacitated/missing; family income within state-prescribed low-income ceiling.
target_beneficiaries: Dependent Children, Orphans, Children of incapacitated parents
application_process: Submit online application at Digital Punjab (eservices.punjab.gov.in) or physically at Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) / District Social Security Office.
required_documents: Child Birth Certificate / School ID, Death Certificate of parent(s) or Medical Disability Certificate of parent, Punjab Residence Proof, Legal Guardian Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.

scheme_name: Widow / Destitute Women Pension Scheme - Punjab
department_name: Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children
description: State Government started a pension for widow and destitute women residing in Punjab to safeguard them from economic destitution.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 credited directly into the beneficiary's bank account via DBT.
eligibility_criteria: Woman residing permanently in Punjab below 58 years of age (transferred to Old Age Pension upon attaining 58); widowed, divorced, deserted, or unmarried destitute woman; annual family income not exceeding ₹60,000.
target_beneficiaries: Widows, Divorced women, Deserted women, Destitute women
application_process: Apply online at Digital Punjab portal (eservices.punjab.gov.in) or submit prescribed application form at local CDPO office or Sewa Kendra.
required_documents: Husband Death Certificate (for widows) or legal decree/Panchayat verification (for divorced/deserted women), Proof of Punjab Residence, Age Proof, Family Income Certificate, Bank Passbook.

department_name: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment and Minorities
description: Financial grant provided to girls belonging to Scheduled Castes, Backward Classes, Christian, Muslim communities and Economically Weaker Sections for their marriage.
benefits: One-time financial assistance grant of ₹51,000 directly transferred to the girl beneficiary's bank account before or upon marriage.
eligibility_criteria: Girl must be 18 years or older at the time of marriage; permanent resident of Punjab; belongs to SC, BC, Christian, Muslim, or Economically Weaker Section (EWS); annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹32,790.
target_beneficiaries: BPL/EWS Girls, SC/BC Girls, Minority Girls of marriageable age
application_process: Submit application online via Ashirwad portal or at Sewa Kendra at least 30 days prior to marriage or within 30 days post-marriage.
required_documents: Caste Certificate (SC/BC) or EWS certificate, Age Proof of bride and groom, Income Certificate, Punjab Residence Certificate, Marriage Invitation Card / Certificate, Bride's Bank Passbook.

department_name: Punjab Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
description: Incentive scheme to celebrate the birth of female children and improve gender ratio among registered construction workers in Punjab.
benefits: Fixed Deposit Receipt of ₹51,000 in the name of the female newborn child (up to two daughters per family) maturing on completion of 18 years.
eligibility_criteria: Parent must be an actively registered building and construction worker with PBOCW Welfare Board with minimum 1 year continuous registration; limited to up to two girl children per family.
target_beneficiaries: Registered Construction Workers, Girl Children of Construction Workers
application_process: Apply to Assistant Labour Commissioner or District Labour Welfare Officer within one year of child's birth.
required_documents: PBOCW Worker Registration Card, Child Birth Certificate, Proof of live membership/regular contribution, Worker Bank Account Passbook, Aadhaar Card.

description: Encourages homeowners to offer clean, comfortable, and affordable home accommodation to tourists and visitors across Punjab without commercial tariff liabilities.
benefits: Exemption from commercial electricity and water tariffs for certified units, official certification and listing on Punjab Tourism portal, marketing support.
eligibility_criteria: Owner must reside in the residential property in Punjab; premises must have 1 to 6 lettable rooms meeting hygiene and safety criteria; police verification clearance required.
target_beneficiaries: Homeowners, Tourism Entrepreneurs, Homestay operators
application_process: Submit application through Punjab Tourism portal or Department of Tourism office with property blueprints and police verification.
required_documents: Property Title Deed / Ownership proof, Building Plan layout, Owner Aadhaar & ID proof, Police Character Verification Certificate, Hygiene & Fire Safety declaration.

description: Initiative to foster rural hospitality, agricultural tourism, and agro-centric tourist experiences in Punjab.
benefits: Official recognition and accreditation by Department of Tourism, inclusion in state tourism circuits and promotional brochures, technical training and guidance.
eligibility_criteria: Must own or lease operational agricultural farm land in Punjab; must provide clean farm-stay lodging compliant with department guidelines; farm owner/manager on site.
target_beneficiaries: Farmers, Agricultural Landowners, Agri-tourism operators
application_process: Submit farm tourism dossier and application to Department of Tourism & Cultural Affairs, Government of Punjab.
required_documents: Land Revenue Record (Jamabandi/Fard) verifying farm ownership, Building Safety & Sanitation Certificate, Owner ID Proof, Photographs of farm and accommodation facilities.

description: State-funded scheme to execute public utility works of emergent nature and fill missing infrastructure gaps not covered under decentralized district schemes. Distributed in 75:25 ratio between Chief Minister and Finance Minister.
benefits: 100% state funding grant for critical civic, developmental, and emergency community infrastructure projects (Outlay of ₹90.00 Cr in FY 2024-25).
eligibility_criteria: Emergent public utility infrastructure works in rural and urban areas of Punjab recommended as per departmental guidelines.
target_beneficiaries: General Public, Rural and Urban Communities of Punjab
application_process: Proposals are sponsored by Administrative Departments or District Authorities for review and approval by CM/FM.
required_documents: Technical estimates, District Planning Committee / Deputy Commissioner recommendation, Administrative justification.

description: Launched in 2005-06 to improve living conditions of people and address felt developmental needs at the grassroots level in consultation with local elected representatives.
benefits: Direct developmental grants allocated and released to districts for community utility assets, link roads, and village amenities (₹17 Cr in FY 2024-25).
eligibility_criteria: Grassroots developmental needs across all 23 districts of Punjab prioritized in consultation with elected representatives.
target_beneficiaries: Rural and Urban Residents of Punjab, Local Communities
application_process: Funds released to districts after approval of Hon’ble Chief Minister; execution monitored by Deputy Commissioners as per prescribed guidelines.
required_documents: Project proposal, Detailed engineering estimates, District Collector sanction note.

scheme_name: Untied Funds of District Planning Committees (DPCs)
description: Enacted under The Punjab District Planning Committees Act 2005 (in compliance with Clause 243ZD of 74th Constitutional Amendment) to decentralize planning and fund district-specific development works.
benefits: District-wise funding grants distributed across 21 active district planning committees as approved by the Finance Minister (FY 2024-25 outlay of ₹13.00 Cr).
eligibility_criteria: District-level public development works approved by nominated District Planning Committees.
target_beneficiaries: Residents of all 23 districts of Punjab
application_process: Annual district plans formulated by DPC under Chairman nominated by CM and submitted to Planning Department for FM sanction.
required_documents: DPC resolution copy, Annual District Plan documentation, Work feasibility estimates.

description: Assistance provided to NGOs for promoting their role in assisting the State in development and social welfare activities across 6 administrative departments (Education, Health, Rural Development, Animal Husbandry, Social Security, Social Welfare).
benefits: Grant-in-aid released to verified NGOs through Apex Committee chaired by Chief Secretary (Allocated outlay of ₹6.00 Cr in FY 2024-25).
eligibility_criteria: Registered NGOs active in Punjab working under the 6 designated departments; mother NGO SOSVA coordinates Health and Social Welfare proposals.
target_beneficiaries: Registered NGOs, Vulnerable populations supported by NGO programs
application_process: Submission of welfare proposals through NIC online monitoring portal or via mother NGO SOSVA for Apex Committee sanction.
required_documents: Society Registration Certificate, 3-Year Audited Accounts, Annual Activity Report, Project Proposal Dossier.

description: Flagship development scheme to rejuvenate public infrastructure, educational amenities, health facilities, and sports grounds across villages and towns of Punjab.
benefits: District-specific capital grants sanctioned directly to Deputy Commissioners for accelerated community infrastructure execution.
eligibility_criteria: Rural and urban public infrastructure projects across Punjab approved under Rangla Punjab scheme guidelines.
target_beneficiaries: Citizens of Punjab, Rural Gram Panchayats, Municipal Councils
application_process: Requisitions and project proposals consolidated by District Collectors and sanctioned by Department of Planning.
required_documents: Project DPR, Geo-tagged site plans, DC verification certificate.

scheme_name: PM-24 Consultancy Seminars / Pilot Study / Quick Survey of Plan Projects
description: Provides grant-in-aid to research and academic institutions (CRRID, IDC, state universities, IIT Ropar, IIM Amritsar) for undertaking analytical studies, surveys, and evaluation of state plan projects.
benefits: Financial grants-in-aid for conducting empirical studies, survey reports, and policy evaluation.
eligibility_criteria: State universities, central institutions, and accredited research think-tanks undertaking research requested by Punjab Administrative Departments.
target_beneficiaries: Research institutions, Policymakers, State Administrative Departments
application_process: Studies proposed by Administrative Departments and sanctioned by Department of Planning on case-by-case basis.
required_documents: Research Project Proposal, Terms of Reference (ToR) approved by Administrative Department, Budget estimate.

description: Standardized institutional framework for appraisal, approval, and monitoring of public schemes and capital projects to ensure accountability and efficiency in state expenditure.
benefits: Institutional governance, rigorous appraisal, and three-tier monitoring for all state investment schemes.
eligibility_criteria: All state administrative departments formulating public investment projects in Punjab.
target_beneficiaries: Punjab State Departments, Public infrastructure sectors
application_process: Projects submitted through 3-tier committee structure (Steering Committee for >₹50 Cr, Standing Committee for ₹20-50 Cr, Departmental Committee for <₹20 Cr).
required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR), Feasibility study, Appraisal memo.

description: Centrally sponsored gap-filling programme implemented in 6 border districts of Punjab (20 blocks, 1,962 villages) along the international border to meet special developmental and security infrastructure needs.
benefits: Funding for health, education, sports, link roads, community centers, drinking water/RO plants, and solar lighting in border villages.
eligibility_criteria: Residents of 1,962 border villages situated within 0-50 km of the international border in Punjab.
target_beneficiaries: Border area population, Rural border communities
application_process: District-level Annual Action Plan formulated in accordance with Ministry of Home Affairs guidelines and approved by State Level Screening Committee.
required_documents: Village Panchayat Requisition, Block Plan, Convergence Verification Certificate.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Punjab)
department_name: Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children
description: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) scheme implemented in Punjab providing non-contributory pensions to destitute BPL elderly citizens.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹200 (ages 60-79) and ₹500 (age 80 and above) transferred directly via DBT.
eligibility_criteria: Resident of Punjab; aged 60 years or above; must belong to a household living Below the Poverty Line (BPL) as per SECC/BPL criteria.
target_beneficiaries: BPL Senior Citizens, Destitute Elderly (60+)
application_process: Apply through Digital Punjab portal or submit application to local CDPO / District Social Security Officer.
required_documents: BPL Card / Income Certificate, Proof of Age, Proof of Punjab Residence, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.

department_name: Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children
description: Centrally sponsored NSAP sub-scheme implemented in Punjab offering one-time financial relief to BPL households upon the death of the primary breadwinner.
benefits: One-time lump sum cash assistance of ₹20,000 paid to the surviving household head via DBT.
eligibility_criteria: BPL family in Punjab; death of the primary breadwinner (male or female aged 18 to 59 years); application made within 12 months of death.
target_beneficiaries: BPL families suffering loss of primary earning member
application_process: Apply online via Digital Punjab or submit application to the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) / District Social Security Officer.
required_documents: Death Certificate of primary breadwinner, BPL Certificate / Family Income Certificate, Proof of Age of deceased, Surviving Family Member Certificate, Bank Passbook.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Mukh Mantri Sehat Bima Yojana (AB-MMSBY)
department_name: Department of Health and Family Welfare
description: Flagship state health insurance scheme providing universal cashless secondary and tertiary health treatment to over 44 lakh beneficiary families in Punjab.
benefits: Cashless treatment coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in empaneled public and private hospitals across 1,600+ medical and surgical packages.
eligibility_criteria: Resident families of Punjab covered under SECC 2011 database, Smart Ration Card holders (NFSA), BOCW-registered construction workers, small and marginal farmers (J-Form holders), small traders (excise-registered), and accredited journalists.
target_beneficiaries: NFSA Cardholders, Construction workers, Small farmers, Low-income families of Punjab
application_process: Eligible beneficiaries generate their e-card at nearest Sewa Kendra, Common Service Centre (CSC), or empaneled hospital Arogya Mitra desk upon Aadhaar verification.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, Smart Ration Card or Punjab Farmer J-form or BOCW registration certificate or SECC letter.

scheme_name: Punjab Free Domestic Electricity Scheme (300 Units Free Power per month)
description: State welfare initiative delivering up to 300 units of free electricity per month (600 units bimonthly) to domestic residential electricity connections across Punjab.
benefits: Zero electricity bill if bimonthly residential consumption is 600 units or less, resulting in direct economic relief on monthly utility expenses.
eligibility_criteria: Domestic consumer with an active residential power connection meter in Punjab. For general categories, consumption exceeding 600 units bimonthly requires paying for the entire consumption; SC/BC/BPL families retain subsidized unit relief.
target_beneficiaries: Domestic electricity consumers, Residential households of Punjab
application_process: Automatically credited and computed directly on the monthly/bimonthly electricity bill generated by PSPCL based on smart/electronic meter reading; no separate physical application form required.
required_documents: PSPCL Electricity Consumer Account Number (Account ID), Aadhaar Card linked to consumer connection.
